The use of the word "threat" automatically politicizes the process whereby certain tasks, usually mundane tasks that are repetitive in nature are done by machines that can do the work at a guaranteed rate and to a specified quality reliably that cannot be done in the same way by human beings. While certain types of 'creative' work will no doubt benefit from "assisstive technologies and A.I. the vast majority of creative work will be done by Human Beings. Work (as an 'occupation') will move into "specializations" that cannot be done by A.I. and/or machines. The real problem is NOT A.I., Robotics, nor is it Automation. The REAL problem is what to do with significant proportions of a country's population that will NOT be in full time employment and how to maintain a flexible, adaptive population that WILL be in employment ?
